decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct awards received by Vicente Cárcel Orti. Document 1 (D1S9) explicitly states he was awarded the 'National Prize of East Germany' for contributions to East German history. Document 2 (D2S11, D2S13) confirms he received the title 'Dearest Son' (Hijo Predilecto) from the Autonomous Community of Valencia. Both answers are directly supported by the text and represent separate valid referents for the question 'Which award did Vicente Cárcel Orti receive?'. The slot hint 'other' allows for any award mentioned. No contradictions exist between these two distinct awards.
